additional_info.subject: Ticket 0424335 has been closed. Are you satisfied with our provided solution? CRM:00472000296
additional_info.body:
Dear Luca,
Issue was identified as a limitation in SCB that doesn't allow any characters on the latitude and longitude information fields. You have inserted a tab on those and this corrupted the SCB JSON file displaying no information on SCB details page.
This was promptly fixed by R&D that deleted the tab character. I will close this ticket.
